Name: KeywordForms
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: KeywordForms, command: one)
SELECT current_time AS time_with_zone, current_timestamp AS stamp_with_zone, localtime AS local_time,
       localtimestamp AS local_stamp, current_date AS today, current_role AS role_name,
       session_user AS session_name
FROM events WHERE id = $1;
Template:
SELECT ⟨c0 aliased:current_time⟩ AS time_with_zone, ⟨c1 aliased:current_timestamp⟩ AS stamp_with_zone, ⟨c2 aliased:localtime⟩ AS local_time,
       ⟨c3 aliased:localtimestamp⟩ AS local_stamp, ⟨c4 aliased:current_date⟩ AS today, ⟨c5 aliased:current_role⟩ AS role_name,
       ⟨c6 aliased:session_user⟩ AS session_name
FROM events WHERE id = ⟨p0⟩;⟨arguments p0⟩

Name: CallForms
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: CallForms, command: one)
SELECT current_date() AS today, current_user() AS user_name, current_role() AS role_name,
       session_user() AS session_name, current_schema() AS schema_name, current_catalog() AS catalog_name,
       get_current_time() AS time_with_zone
FROM events WHERE id = $1;
Template:
SELECT ⟨c0 aliased:current_date()⟩ AS today, ⟨c1 aliased:current_user()⟩ AS user_name, ⟨c2 aliased:current_role()⟩ AS role_name,
       ⟨c3 aliased:session_user()⟩ AS session_name, ⟨c4 aliased:current_schema()⟩ AS schema_name, ⟨c5 aliased:current_catalog()⟩ AS catalog_name,
       ⟨c6 aliased:get_current_time()⟩ AS time_with_zone
FROM events WHERE id = ⟨p0⟩;⟨arguments p0⟩
